mainText: Morning market briefing for Tuesday, November third. Futures are mixed: the S and P 500 is flat to down a tenth of a percent, the Nasdaq 100 is up three tenths of a percent on a chip rebound, and the Dow is down six tenths of a percent on Apple's earnings drag. The 10-year Treasury yield is 4.93 percent, up slightly from Monday. Big movers: Shopify down 16 to 18 percent after third quarter revenue just matched consensus. Palantir down 7 to 8 percent in a post-earnings slide. Apple down over 4 percent after guiding holiday margins to 45 to 46 percent versus 46.9 expected, citing rising memory chip costs. A M D up 2.8 percent ahead of its report after the close. Ascendis Pharma up nearly 20 percent. The midterms are today, oil is around 106 to 110 dollars, and the Nasdaq 100 confirmed a correction on Monday.
